endorsements.name: Alain Rödel
endorsements.label: CVE-2021-23883
endorsements.description: A Null Pointer Dereference vulnerability in McAfee Endpoint Security (ENS) for Windows prior to 10.7.0 February 2021 Update allows a local administrator to cause Windows to crash via a specific system call which is not handled correctly. This varies by machine and had partial protection prior to this update.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 4)
